contests_configuration_schedule.name: contests_configuration_schedule
contests_configuration_schedule.value:
("contests"."judging_start_at" IS NULL AND "contests"."judging_deadline_at" IS NULL AND "contests"."published_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("contests"."start_at" IS NOT NULL AND "contests"."end_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "contests"."judging_start_at" IS NOT NULL AND "contests"."judging_deadline_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "contests"."published_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "contests"."start_at" < "contests"."end_at" AND "contests"."end_at" < "contests"."judging_start_at"
        AND "contests"."judging_start_at" < "contests"."judging_deadline_at" AND "contests"."judging_deadline_at" < "contests"."published_at")

uq_round_active_contest.name: uq_round_active_contest
uq_round_active_contest.where: "judging_rounds"."started_at" is not null and "judging_rounds"."locked_at" is null

judging_round_values.name: judging_round_values
judging_round_values.value:
"judging_rounds"."position" > 0 and "judging_rounds"."start_at" < "judging_rounds"."deadline_at"
    and "judging_rounds"."required_judges" > 0 and ("judging_rounds"."advance_count" is null or "judging_rounds"."advance_count" > 0)
